create_linear_apot_module: create a LinearAPoT quantized linear module from a weight tensor with bit width b and block size k
decompose_apot_weights: decompose APoT quantized weight values into k-sized binary blocks for bitshift multiplication
compute_bitshift_multiplication: compute weight-activation multiplication using bitshifting instead of standard matrix multiplication
run_apot_matmul_forward: run forward pass of APoT quantized linear layer with uniformly quantized activation input
test_linear_apot_quantization: test the APoT quantization pipeline with observer, quantization parameters, and forward pass
